design.sampleSizePolicy: Pilot variance plus prespecified minimum meaningful effect; no automatic sufficiency claim.

metrics.definition: oracle-matched true findings / all findings
metrics.controls: Held-out logical fault findings; duplicate reports deduplicated

metrics.definition: detected eligible oracle faults / eligible oracle faults
metrics.controls: Per defect class, workflow family and static/runtime phase

metrics.definition: valid workflows with spurious findings / valid workflows
metrics.controls: Do not use defect variants as negatives

metrics.definition: eligible workflows / all proposed workflows
metrics.controls: Unsupported and unavailable encodings reported explicitly

metrics.definition: matched findings with correct primary location / matched findings
metrics.controls: Use independent logical-fault locations

metrics.definition: replayed modeled counterexamples rejected by runtime / replayable modeled counterexamples
metrics.controls: Report unencodable or conservative traces separately

metrics.definition: correctly completed eligible tasks / eligible tasks
metrics.controls: Pending, rejected and recovery_failed are not completed

metrics.definition: count each of proved/counterexample/unknown/unsupported/timeout/harness_error
metrics.controls: Preserve every resource-limited run

metrics.definition: elapsed time and peak RSS by states/transitions explored
metrics.controls: Vary domains, fields, budgets, branching, history and recovery

metrics.definition: per-stage elapsed time and peak RSS by actual V and E
metrics.controls: Initialization separate; resolution/lowering currently fused

metrics.definition: T_enforced - T_matched_baseline; T_enforced / T_matched_baseline
metrics.controls: Identical callbacks, traces, state and matched safety constraints

metrics.definition: journal bytes or events / logical operations
metrics.controls: Record SQLite mode, fsync/storage, checkpoints and database growth

metrics.definition: remote mutations under pre-invocation denial / denied invocations
metrics.controls: Service-side oracle independent of Panini logs

metrics.definition: local commits after commit-phase denial / commit-phase denials
metrics.controls: Remote action may already have occurred; distinct from pre-invoke denial

metrics.definition: extra remote commits for a logical business action / logical business actions
metrics.controls: Business identity distinct from per-visit idempotency keys

metrics.definition: uncertain mutations blocked until final reconciliation / uncertain mutations
metrics.controls: Blocking does not imply eventual completion

metrics.definition: service-oracle-confirmed successful compensations / recovery-required effects
metrics.controls: Attempt count is not success; irreversible actions reported separately

metrics.definition: time from fault detection to reconciled recovery; censor unresolved outcomes
metrics.controls: Report completion probability alongside conditional latency quantiles

metrics.definition: oracle-correct decisions / nonabstained decisions; abstentions / decisions
metrics.controls: Hold prompts/input/option count/provider/version fixed; report coverage and end-task quality

metrics.definition: paired recall/completion differences and latency ratios on common eligible workflows
metrics.controls: Cluster intervals by workflow family; same budgets and resources

metrics.definition: per-machine process-level stage statistics under matching workload
metrics.controls: Two machines support a narrow hardware comparison, not universal generality
